title.en: An Act Making Appropriation for the Repair and Construction of Roads, Bridges, Trails and Public Buildings in the Mountain Province.

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in Mountain Province, the Insular Treasury not
otherwise appropriated, the sum of one hundred thousand pesos for the repair and construction of roads,
bridges, trails, and public buildings in the Mountain Province.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, November 27, 1911.
